title: Concepts
subtitle: Mental model for drafts, paths, and subscriptions
description: How qortex-resource thinks about source data, drafts, and fine-grained updates.
content: Understanding three ideas unlocks the rest of the API: source vs draft, path overrides, and subscription grain.

sections.title: Source vs draft
sections.content:
**Source (`data`)** is the last known server/store value.

**Draft** is source plus a Map of path overrides. Edits never mutate source until save succeeds (unless you use optimistic mode, which updates source early and rolls back on failure).

sections.title: Path overrides
sections.content: `set('addresses.0.city', 'NYC')` records an override at that path. Reading `draft` applies overrides on top of source. `changedFields` lists override keys. `resetDraft()` clears all overrides; `reset('addresses.0.city')` clears one path (and nested keys under it).

sections.title: Subscription grain
sections.content:
• `subscribe(listener)` — full snapshot (status, draft, errors, mutation…)
• `subscribeField(path, listener)` — that path and related ancestor/descendant notifies

React `useField` uses field subscriptions so typing one input does not re-render the whole form.

sections.title: Features from config
sections.content:
There is no public plugin API. Turn features on via config only:

• `validate` → client validation
• `persist` → local draft/cache
• `mutation.optimistic` → optimistic save
• `source.fetch` / `query` / `state` / value+onChange → how data enters the resource

sections.title: Identity (`key`)
sections.content: `key` may be a string/number or a tuple like `['product', workspaceId, productId]`. It identifies persist storage and (in React) when to recreate the resource instance.
